dek: Renowned Hong Kong lyricist Peter Lai, who spearheaded the city’s golden era of Cantonese pop music, has died aged 76, his family and friends said Thursday. Lai was hospitalised after suffering a stroke this year and passed away on Wednesday morning, his son and a long-time friend said at a press conference. Nicknamed
